name: Ratling Trick Feature
summary: Ratling Trick Feature Long-Las Sniper Your first Accurate weapon hit each combat adds +1d6 damage. Underhive Rat Climbing, crawling, squeezing, and moving through tight spaces costs you no extra movement. Spotter Your mark also adds +1 damage. Black-Market Gremlin Once per session, produce one plausible piece of minor contraband or ammunition.
